next.reason: 1985: "The results are the same as if the user had referred to each pair of corresponding identifiers in separate MOVE statements."; 2023: "except that if subscripting is specified for identifier-3 or identifier-4, the subscript value used is that resulting from the evaluation". 2023 keeps the separate-MOVE equivalence but adds an exception: subscripts are evaluated once, at the start of the statement. That can change results when a move alters a subscript.
